name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands 'reach the goal' unconditionally and as a hard requirement, but the only clause is Precedence(has_key, at_goal), which restricts ordering without making at_goal happen — FINAL_STATES is empty and the rule-only warning fires although this is not a restriction-only task. Add a hard Existence(at_goal); with Precedence(has_key, at_goal) it also forces has_key, so no separate Existence(has_key) is needed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_goal) hard with Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard captures 'Pick up the key, then reach the goal' — the goal is required and the key must come first; together they force has_key, so no Existence(has_key) is needed.

texts: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.
